title: Protocol PDF: render the hwdesk_protocol template with dompdf, store under private://hwdesk/protocols
interface:
final class ProtocolPdf. Constructor: __construct(\Drupal\Core\Render\RendererInterface $renderer, \Drupal\file\FileRepositoryInterface $fileRepository, \Drupal\Core\File\FileSystemInterface $fileSystem, \Drupal\Core\Config\ConfigFactoryInterface $configFactory, \Drupal\Core\Datetime\DateFormatterInterface $dateFormatter). Service 'hwdesk.protocol_pdf' (registered).
render(\Drupal\hwdesk\Entity\Handover $handover): string -- PDF bytes. Build the render array ['#theme' => 'hwdesk_protocol', '#handover' => $handover, '#asset' => $handover->getAsset(), '#employee' => $handover->getUser(), '#admin' => $handover->getRequestedBy(), '#company' => (string) config('hwdesk.settings')->get('company_name'), '#confirmed_at' => $dateFormatter->format($handover->getDecided() ?? time(), 'custom', 'j. n. Y H:i')], render it with $renderer->renderInIsolation($build) (cast to string), then Dompdf: $dompdf = new \Dompdf\Dompdf(new \Dompdf\Options(['isRemoteEnabled' => FALSE, 'defaultFont' => 'DejaVu Sans'])); $dompdf->loadHtml($html, 'UTF-8'); $dompdf->setPaper('A4'); $dompdf->render(); return (string) $dompdf->output(). Asset or user missing -> \InvalidArgumentException.
store(Handover $handover): \Drupal\file\FileInterface -- protocol number empty -> \InvalidArgumentException. Destination 'private://hwdesk/protocols/<protocol_number>.pdf'; $fileSystem->prepareDirectory($dir, FileSystemInterface::CREATE_DIRECTORY | FileSystemInterface::MODIFY_PERMISSIONS) first; $file = $fileRepository->writeData($this->render($handover), $destination, \Drupal\Core\File\FileExists::Replace); $file->setPermanent(); $file->setMimeType('application/pdf'); $file->save(); return $file. Storing twice for the same number must not create a second file entity for the same URI (FileExists::Replace reuses it).
The template hwdesk-protocol.html.twig and hook_theme already exist; do not create templates. File header: <?php + declare(strict_types=1); namespace Drupal\hwdesk\Service; final class; constructor property promotion with readonly; no \Drupal:: static calls (everything is injected); no other new files.
Změna z 29. 10. 2026 (předávák): do protokolu patří i text, se kterým zaměstnanec souhlasil.
renderHtml(\Drupal\hwdesk\Entity\Handover $handover): string -- veřejná metoda, která složí render array a vrátí hotové HTML: (string) $this->renderer->renderInIsolation($build). render() ji použije a HTML si už neskládá sám. Build je stejný jako dosud a navíc:
  '#terms' => text, se kterým zaměstnanec souhlasil, vzatý z $handover->get('terms')->value (NE z konfigurace -- ta se od té doby mohla změnit). Prázdný nebo NULL text -> '#terms' => NULL. Jinak ['#markup' => \Drupal\Component\Utility\Xss::filterAdmin((string) $handover->get('terms')->value)], takže se z něj do PDF dostanou nadpisy, odstavce a odrážky, ale ne skript.
  '#consented_at' => čas zaškrtnutí souhlasu: $handover->get('consented')->value je prázdné -> '', jinak $this->dateFormatter->format((int) $handover->get('consented')->value, 'custom', 'j. n. Y H:i').
Obě nové proměnné jsou už ohlášené v hwdesk_theme() ('terms', 'consented_at'); nic jiného do buildu nepřidávej a nic z něj neubírej.
database: entities through the injected services only
